==Notes==
*Upon using an offensive job ability or weapon skill, there is a chance that a hint to one job ability or weapon skill [[Voidwatch Weaknesses|vulnerability]] will be revealed.
**If a weapon skill vulnerability is revealed, the type of weapon, or "automaton," will be shown.
**If a job ability vulnerability is revealed, the job that natively learns that ability will be shown.
**If a pet ability vulnerability is revealed, the type of pet will be shown (avatar, wyvern, automaton, or "pet," which refers to [[beastmaster]] jug pets).
***Possession of a [[Periapt of sapience]] will enhance the pet-related messages to show the element of the avatar, the element of the wyvern breath, the monster family of the pet, or the frame of the automaton.
